properties.source: Drawn by hand from Britannica's text description, not its map images. Eastern Eurasian Steppe drawn at continental scale, east of NE 'KAZAKH STEPPE': through northern Dzungaria (Emin valley, Ulungur, Zaysan) and the Mongolian Great Lakes depression, the central and eastern Mongolian steppe between the Khangai/Khentii forest-steppe and the Gobi, Hulunbuir, and the Manchurian steppe of the Songnen and Horqin plains. Extents from Britannica 'Steppe' and the WWF ecoregion descriptions (Emin Valley steppe, Mongolian–Manchurian grassland); no ecoregion geometry copied. Approximate.
